basis_statement: Audit rows are ordered strictly inside a stream and only secondarily merged for operator explanation, so review never confuses narrative grouping with the append-only source of truth.
compare_and_swap_policy: head compare-and-swap uses expected previous hash when a caller supplies one and fails closed on drift
duplicate_publication_policy: same stream plus same publication ref returns the existing row only when the semantic payload hash is identical
signature_failure_posture: signature batch failure is recorded as follow-up batch metadata and never rewrites previously appended rows
notes: The first row in a stream starts at sequence 1 and carries prev_event_hash = null.
Broken heads with sequence > 0 and a missing last_event_hash must fail closed before append.

source_lineage.rationale: Anchors one-based append-only sequencing and monotonic head semantics.
Documents the append-only ledger and mutable head split already established in storage.
